messages:
maya: Heads-up — a customer asked for the ability to filter audit exports by a 'sensitivity' tag on routing policy changes. Can we add tags + sampling controls?
sam: Do we mean a label on the policy itself (public/internal/confidential) or a label on each change event? need to be specific.
devon: Prefer policy-level. We already carry lifecycle metadata on policies; adding a small 'sensitivity' enum shouldn't be heavy.
ana: (typo) ana: We also need telemetry: sampled vs full event counts, and export size estimates in the console. Otherwise SRE will get surprised by spikes.
leo: Quick API sketch:
```
PATCH /v1/routing-policies/{policy_id}
{ "sensitivity": "confidential" }

Export: GET /v1/audit/exports?sensitivity=confidential&sample_rate=0.05
```
maya: That looks reasonable. But how do we handle historical events? If we tag a policy today, should exports from last month suddenly show as confidential? Legal asked for clear behaviour.
irene: Legal perspective: exports must reflect the sensitivity at the time of the change. We can't retroactively mark old events as confidential. So events need an event.metadata.sensitivity and event.metadata.sensitivity_applied_at (timestamp when the tag was active).
devon: Implementation idea: persist event.metadata.sensitivity (nullable) at write-time. If tag changes later, we write a policy.update event with new sensitivity. Exporter filters on event.metadata.sensitivity (or sensitivity_applied_at range). For sampling, use deterministic sampling key = tenant_id + sensitivity to keep sampling stable across retries.
audit-bot: scheduled export job queued — job_id=0xA3; tenant=acme-corp; filters={sensitivity: "confidential", sample_rate: 0.05} :hourglass_flowing_sand:
ana: (ana) UX ask: Console export modal should show estimated rows and bytes, a note if the policy was tagged after the event window ("Some events may be untagged"), and an 'include_untagged' toggle.
sam: Also think about quotas: per-tenant export quotas split by sensitivity class. Confidential exports probably need approval and should come from a separate quota bucket.
maya: Good call. I'll draft a short proposal doc for product/legal. Can someone put together a minimal PR with the API shape + migration plan? @devon @leo
devon: I'll open a PR tomorrow AM. Implementation constraints: no retro-tagging, exporter filters on event.metadata.sensitivity, and we'll emit metrics: audit.export.sampled_count{sens=...} and audit.export.full_count{sens=...} so ops can track.
leo: I'll wire a mock in the console export modal to show estimates and the include_untagged toggle; will need an API endpoint to surface sample-size estimates (fast path).
maya: Thanks — sounds like a plan. Follow-ups: PR, console mock, and small migration note for onboarding docs.
